Computational tools for solving and analyzing economic models: programming in Python, working with economic data, numerical methods, microeconomic applications, estimation, and agent-based modeling.

## This week

**Week 1: Course introduction and setup.** Read the [Week 1 notebook](weeks/week01.ipynb) and complete the [Setup guide](setup.qmd) and PS01.

### Start here

1.  **Set up your codespace** with the [Setup guide](setup.qmd) before the second class session. It runs in your web browser, so there's nothing to install.
2.  **Stuck?** Check the [Setup FAQ](setup-faq.qmd), then post on Discussions.
3.  **Each week**, the [Schedule](schedule.qmd) links that week's readings and lecture notebooks.
